sources.excerpt: 3 SERIES FUZZ by JHS Pedals | The Guitar Pedal Directory Effect Pedals Manufacturers Effect Types Guitar Effect Pedal by JHS Pedals 3 SERIES FUZZ The JHS Pedals 3 Series Fuzz combines affordability and high quality. The JHS Pedals 3 Series Fuzz is a versatile fuzz box designed to balance vintage and modern sounds. It cleans up well with the guitar's volume knob, offering soaring sustain and clear articulation. Featuring a Bias knob, it allows for a more gated sound, expanding the tonal possibilities. Uniquely, the fuzz knob maintains usability across the entire sweep, enabling various tones often not found in typical fuzz pedals, including distortion and overdrive. The Fat toggle enhances the bass response, delivering a fuller sound. Made with high-quality parts in Kansas City, MO, it embodies the company's commitment to quality and simplicity. This pedal runs on 9V DC Negative Center power and consumes 9mA.
